sanjay: quick flag 0 saw canary traffic route to v2, fall back to v1, and v2 quota was still charged. small experiments getting noise.

tasha: ouch. we need a safe opt-in so canaries don't inflate tenant quota.

ben: proposal: edge inserts signed header `x-rd-fallthrough: canary` when token is in experiment list; quota-service treats that header as a non-billed hint.

oli: agree but only honor header when HMAC verified and cohort in whitelist. add short dedupe TTL 30s to avoid double counting.

ben: console: per-tenant toggle "Exclude fallthrough from quota (beta)" default OFF, only tenant admins. show `fallthrough_exempt_units` metric.

sanjay: telemetry: emit `fallthrough.exempt_applied` + `exempt_audit_id`. billing will mark `exempt_invoice=false` so invoices unaffected but auditable.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy at 2024-11-15T09:00:00Z for internal tenants.

tasha: I'll own runbook and dashboard widget. oli: pls add signature verification in quota-service PR.

ben: finance ok as long as exportable audit rows exist.

sanjay: let's canary internal tenants 48hrs then reassess.
